title: The benefits of a bilingual brain - Mia Nacamulli
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】雙語大腦的好處 - Mia Nacamulli（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: ¿Hablas español? Parlez-vous français? 你会说中文吗？ If you answered, "sí," "oui," or "会" and you're watching this in English,
cues.en: ¿Hablas español? Parlez-vous français? 你会说中文吗？ If you answered, "sí," "oui," or "会" and you're watching this in English,
cues.zh: ¿ Hablas español？ Parlez-vous Français？ 你會說中文嗎？ 如果你回答“sí”、“oui”或“會”，並且你正在觀看英語節目，

cues.text: chances are you belong to the world's bilingual and multilingual majority.
cues.en: chances are you belong to the world's bilingual and multilingual majority.
cues.zh: 您很可能屬於世界上雙語和多語群體的大多數。

cues.text: And besides having an easier time traveling or watching movies without subtitles,
cues.en: And besides having an easier time traveling or watching movies without subtitles,
cues.zh: 除了更輕鬆地旅行或觀看沒有字幕的電影之外，

cues.text: knowing two or more languages means that your brain may actually look and work differently than those of your monolingual friends.
cues.en: knowing two or more languages means that your brain may actually look and work differently than those of your monolingual friends.
cues.zh: 瞭解兩種或多種語言意味著您的大腦實際上可能與只會說一種語言的朋友不同。

cues.text: So what does it really mean to know a language?
cues.en: So what does it really mean to know a language?
cues.zh: 那麼瞭解一門語言到底意味著什麼呢？

cues.text: Language ability is typically measured in two active parts, speaking and writing,
cues.en: Language ability is typically measured in two active parts, speaking and writing,
cues.zh: 語言能力通常透過兩個活動部分來衡量，即口語和寫作，

cues.text: and two passive parts, listening and reading.
cues.en: and two passive parts, listening and reading.
cues.zh: 以及兩個被動部分，聽力和閱讀。

cues.text: While a balanced bilingual has near equal abilities across the board in two languages,
cues.en: While a balanced bilingual has near equal abilities across the board in two languages,
cues.zh: 雖然平衡的雙語者在兩種語言上的能力幾乎相同，

cues.text: most bilinguals around the world know and use their languages in varying proportions.
cues.en: most bilinguals around the world know and use their languages in varying proportions.
cues.zh: 世界上大多數雙語者都以不同的比例瞭解和使用他們的語言。

cues.text: And depending on their situation and how they acquired each language,
cues.en: And depending on their situation and how they acquired each language,
cues.zh: 根據他們的情況以及他們習得每種語言的方式，

cues.text: they can be classified into three general types.
cues.en: they can be classified into three general types.
cues.zh: 它們可分為三種一般型別。

cues.text: For example, let's take Gabriella, whose family immigrates to the US from Peru when she's two-years old.
cues.en: For example, let's take Gabriella, whose family immigrates to the US from Peru when she's two-years old.
cues.zh: 以加布裡埃拉為例，她在兩歲時隨家人從秘魯移民到美國。

cues.text: As a compound bilingual, Gabriella develops two linguistic codes simultaneously,
cues.en: As a compound bilingual, Gabriella develops two linguistic codes simultaneously,
cues.zh: 作為複合雙語者，加布裡埃拉同時開發了兩種語言程式碼，

cues.text: with a single set of concepts, learning both English and Spanish
cues.en: with a single set of concepts, learning both English and Spanish
cues.zh: 使用一組概念，學習英語和西班牙語

cues.text: as she begins to process the world around her.
cues.en: as she begins to process the world around her.
cues.zh: 當她開始處理周圍的世界。

cues.text: Her teenage brother, on the other hand, might be a coordinate bilingual,
cues.en: Her teenage brother, on the other hand, might be a coordinate bilingual,
cues.zh: 另一方面，她十幾歲的弟弟可能是雙語者，

cues.text: working with two sets of concepts, learning English in school,
cues.en: working with two sets of concepts, learning English in school,
cues.zh: 使用兩組概念，在學校學習英語，

cues.text: while continuing to speak Spanish at home and with friends.
cues.en: while continuing to speak Spanish at home and with friends.
cues.zh: 同時繼續在家裡和朋友說西班牙語。

cues.text: Finally, Gabriella's parents are likely to be subordinate bilinguals
cues.en: Finally, Gabriella's parents are likely to be subordinate bilinguals
cues.zh: 最後，加布裡埃拉的父母很可能是從屬雙語者

cues.text: who learn a secondary language by filtering it through their primary language.
cues.en: who learn a secondary language by filtering it through their primary language.
cues.zh: 透過主要語言過濾來學習第二語言的人。

cues.text: Because all types of bilingual people can become fully proficient in a language
cues.en: Because all types of bilingual people can become fully proficient in a language
cues.zh: 因為所有型別的雙語人士都可以完全精通一種語言

cues.text: regardless of accent or pronunciation, the difference may not be apparent to a casual observer.
cues.en: regardless of accent or pronunciation, the difference may not be apparent to a casual observer.
cues.zh: 無論口音或發音如何，對於不經意的觀察者來說，差異可能並不明顯。

cues.text: But recent advances in brain imaging technology have given neurolinguists a glimpse
cues.en: But recent advances in brain imaging technology have given neurolinguists a glimpse
cues.zh: 但腦造影技術的最新進展讓神經語言學家得以一睹

cues.text: into how specific aspects of language learning affect the bilingual brain.
cues.en: into how specific aspects of language learning affect the bilingual brain.
cues.zh: 研究語言學習的具體方面如何影響雙語大腦。

cues.text: It's well known that the brain's left hemisphere is more dominant and analytical in logical processes,
cues.en: It's well known that the brain's left hemisphere is more dominant and analytical in logical processes,
cues.zh: 眾所周知，大腦的左半球在邏輯過程中更具主導性和分析性，

cues.text: while the right hemisphere is more active in emotional and social ones,
cues.en: while the right hemisphere is more active in emotional and social ones,
cues.zh: 而右半球在情感和社交上更活躍，

cues.text: though this is a matter of degree, not an absolute split.
cues.en: though this is a matter of degree, not an absolute split.
cues.zh: 雖然這是一個程度的問題，而不是絕對的分裂。

cues.text: The fact that language involves both types of functions while lateralization develops gradually with age,
cues.en: The fact that language involves both types of functions while lateralization develops gradually with age,
cues.zh: 事實上，語言涉及兩種型別的功能，而偏側化隨著年齡的增長而逐漸發展，

cues.text: has lead to the critical period hypothesis.
cues.en: has lead to the critical period hypothesis.
cues.zh: 從而引出了關鍵期假說。

cues.text: According to this theory, children learn languages more easily
cues.en: According to this theory, children learn languages more easily
cues.zh: 根據這個理論，孩子學習語言比較容易

cues.text: because the plasticity of their developing brains lets them use both hemispheres in language acquisition,
cues.en: because the plasticity of their developing brains lets them use both hemispheres in language acquisition,
cues.zh: 因為他們正在發育的大腦的可塑性使他們能夠在語言習得中同時使用兩個半球，

cues.text: while in most adults, language is lateralized to one hemisphere,
cues.en: while in most adults, language is lateralized to one hemisphere,
cues.zh: 而對多數成年人來說，語言偏向一個半球，

cues.text: usually the left.
cues.en: usually the left.
cues.zh: 通常是左邊。

cues.text: If this is true, learning a language in childhood may give you a more holistic grasp of its social and emotional contexts.
cues.en: If this is true, learning a language in childhood may give you a more holistic grasp of its social and emotional contexts.
cues.zh: 如果這是真的，那麼在童年時期學習語言可能會讓你更全面地掌握其社會和情感背景。

cues.text: Conversely, recent research showed that people who learned a second language in adulthood
cues.en: Conversely, recent research showed that people who learned a second language in adulthood
cues.zh: 相反，最近的研究表明，在成年後學習第二語言的人

cues.text: exhibit less emotional bias and a more rational approach
cues.en: exhibit less emotional bias and a more rational approach
cues.zh: 表現出較少的情緒偏見和更理性的方法

cues.text: when confronting problems in the second language than in their native one.
cues.en: when confronting problems in the second language than in their native one.
cues.zh: 當用第二語言遇到問題時，而不是用母語遇到問題時。

cues.text: But regardless of when you acquire additional languages, being multilingual gives your brain some remarkable advantages.
cues.en: But regardless of when you acquire additional languages, being multilingual gives your brain some remarkable advantages.
cues.zh: 但無論您何時獲得其他語言，掌握多種語言都會為您的大腦帶來一些顯著的優勢。

cues.text: Some of these are even visible, such as higher density of the grey matter
cues.en: Some of these are even visible, such as higher density of the grey matter
cues.zh: 其中一些甚至是可見的，例如灰質密度更高

cues.text: that contains most of your brain's neurons and synapses, and more activity in certain regions when engaging a second language.
cues.en: that contains most of your brain's neurons and synapses, and more activity in certain regions when engaging a second language.
cues.zh: 它包含大腦的大部分神經元和突觸，並且在使用第二語言時某些區域的活動會更多。

cues.text: The heightened workout a bilingual brain receives throughout its life can also help delay the onset of diseases, like Alzheimer's and dementia
cues.en: The heightened workout a bilingual brain receives throughout its life can also help delay the onset of diseases, like Alzheimer's and dementia
cues.zh: 雙語大腦在一生中接受的強化運動也有助於延緩阿茲海默症和痴呆症等疾病的發作

cues.text: by as much as five years.
cues.en: by as much as five years.
cues.zh: 長達五年。

cues.text: The idea of major cognitive benefits to bilingualism may seem intuitive now,
cues.en: The idea of major cognitive benefits to bilingualism may seem intuitive now,
cues.zh: 雙語對認知的主要好處的想法現在看起來似乎很直觀，

cues.text: but it would have surprised earlier experts.
cues.en: but it would have surprised earlier experts.
cues.zh: 但這會讓早期的專家感到驚訝。

cues.text: Before the 1960s, bilingualism was considered a handicap
cues.en: Before the 1960s, bilingualism was considered a handicap
cues.zh: 在1960年代以前，雙語被認為是一種障礙

cues.text: that slowed a child's development by forcing them to spend too much energy distinguishing between languages,
cues.en: that slowed a child's development by forcing them to spend too much energy distinguishing between languages,
cues.zh: 迫使孩子花費太多精力來區分語言，從而減緩了孩子的發展，

cues.text: a view based largely on flawed studies.
cues.en: a view based largely on flawed studies.
cues.zh: 這種觀點主要基於有缺陷的研究。

cues.text: And while a more recent study did show that reaction times and errors increase for some bilingual students
cues.en: And while a more recent study did show that reaction times and errors increase for some bilingual students
cues.zh: 雖然最近的一項研究確實表明一些雙語學生的反應時間和錯誤會增加

cues.text: in cross-language tests, it also showed that the effort and attention needed
cues.en: in cross-language tests, it also showed that the effort and attention needed
cues.zh: 在跨語言測試中，也表明需要付出努力和關注

cues.text: to switch between languages triggered more activity in, and potentially strengthened, the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex.
cues.en: to switch between languages triggered more activity in, and potentially strengthened, the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex.
cues.zh: 在語言之間切換會引發更多背外側前額葉皮質的活動，並有可能加強。

cues.text: This is the part of the brain that plays a large role in executive function, problem solving, switching between tasks,
cues.en: This is the part of the brain that plays a large role in executive function, problem solving, switching between tasks,
cues.zh: 這是大腦的一部分，在執行功能、解決問題、任務切換、

cues.text: and focusing while filtering out irrelevant information.
cues.en: and focusing while filtering out irrelevant information.
cues.zh: 並集中註意力，同時過濾掉不相關的資訊。

cues.text: So, while bilingualism may not necessarily make you smarter,
cues.en: So, while bilingualism may not necessarily make you smarter,
cues.zh: 因此，雖然雙語不一定會讓你更聰明，

cues.text: it does make your brain more healthy, complex and actively engaged,
cues.en: it does make your brain more healthy, complex and actively engaged,
cues.zh: 它確實會讓你的大腦更健康、複雜和積極參與，

cues.text: and even if you didn't have the good fortune of learning a second language as a child,
cues.en: and even if you didn't have the good fortune of learning a second language as a child,
cues.zh: 即使你小時候沒有幸運地學習第二語言，

cues.text: it's never too late to do yourself a favor and make the linguistic leap from, "Hello,"
cues.en: it's never too late to do yourself a favor and make the linguistic leap from, "Hello,"
cues.zh: 幫自己一個忙，從「你好」開始進行語言上的飛躍，永遠不會太晚。

cues.text: to, "Hola," "Bonjour" or "你好’s" because when it comes to our brains a little exercise can go a long way.
cues.en: to, "Hola," "Bonjour" or "你好’s" because when it comes to our brains a little exercise can go a long way.
cues.zh: 說“Hola”、“Bonjour”或“你好”，因為對於我們的大腦來說，一點點運動就能大有幫助。
